description: FINAL districts approved. Completes legal adoption of boundaries for all 585 mahallas of Tashkent City. Geometry published as SHP + PDF on opendata.tashkent.uz. THIS IS THE LEGAL BASIS FOR THE CURRENT MAHALLA LAYER.

State Register of administrative-territorial units created inside the state land cadastre, run by the Cadastre Agency. MHOBT/SOATO codes assigned by the National Statistics Committee within 2 working days. THIS IS THE AUTHORITATIVE ROUTE TO VERIFY SOATO CODES.

Unified Register of Mahalla Citizens' Assemblies established inside Raqamli Mahalla. Holds per-mahalla: full and short name, auto-assigned mahalla code, STIR (tax ID), Kengash decision number and date, territory and GEOSPATIAL BOUNDARY. Operator: O'zbekiston Mahallalari Uyushmasi. Launched 01.12.2025; agencies aligned by 01.01.2026. NOT PUBLIC - this single export would close nearly every gap in this dataset.
